sentences.en: Sami was trying to lure Layla back into his life.
sentences.zh: 萨米试图用他的魅力将莱拉重新带回到他的生活中。

sentences.en: I was lured to the store by the advertisement.
sentences.zh: 我被广告吸引到了商店里。

sentences.en: I could not resist the lure of great profits.
sentences.zh: 我无法抵挡巨大利润的诱惑。

senses.zh: 诱饵，诱惑物；吸引力，魅力
